content:
“If it ain't broke, don't fix it!”

**Lucky Break** is a Luck-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Equipped armor repairs itself when attacked.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | Chance your equipped armor will greatly repair itself when struck. | 00356A08 | 
| ★★ | 2 | Chance your equipped armor will repair itself even more when struck. | 00356A07 | 
| ★ | 1 | Slight chance your equipped armor will repair itself when struck. | 00356A06 | 

Lucky Break has equal chance to repair any armor (no power armor) at each rank. The magnitude of the repair is based on perk rank:

| Perk rank | Chance per hit marker | Repair magnitude | 
| 1 | 0.30% | 30 x condition loss | 
| 2 | 0.30% | 60 x condition loss | 
| 3 | 0.30% | 90 x condition loss | 

- Lucky Break does not trigger when wearing power armor or hazmat suits.
- Lucky Break will trigger while wearing the Cave diving suit, Garb of Mysteries and Chinese stealth armor.
- Lucky Break will trigger even if the incoming damage is reduced to 0.

- Lucky Break does not trigger while wearing hazmat suits or the Garb of Mysteries. [verified]
